NAME
    ls - List machine generations

SYNOPSIS

    confctl [global options] generation ls [command options] [machine-pattern [generation-pattern]]

COMMAND OPTIONS
    -a, --attr=arg    - Filter by attribute (may be used more than once,
                        default: none)
    -l, --[no-]local  - List local build generations
    -r, --[no-]remote - List remote machine generations
    -t, --tag=arg     - Filter by tag (may be used more than once, default:
                        none)
